name: File evaluation request
auto_rationale: This task involves straightforward data entry that can be fully automated.
evidence: An evaluation request is filed electronically through a bank terminal or the integrated platform.
description: An evaluation request is filed electronically through a bank terminal or the integrated platform.

name: Check applicant company's basic information
auto_rationale: This task requires human judgment to verify the accuracy of the information.
evidence: the TCB business team checks the applicant company's basic information
description: The team checks the applicant company's basic information.

name: Email upload link for document submission
auto_rationale: This task involves sending a standard email which can be automated.
evidence: emails an upload link on the integrated platform, requesting scraping consent and document submission.
description: The team emails an upload link requesting scraping consent and document submission.

name: Collect financial statements and documents
auto_rationale: This task can be fully automated as it involves data scraping.
evidence: the financial statements, business registration certificate, and shareholder status are collected automatically
description: Financial statements and documents are collected automatically if consent is given.

name: Upload company profile and product catalog
auto_rationale: This task requires manual input and cannot be automated.
evidence: the company profile and product catalog are uploaded manually.
description: The team uploads the company profile and product catalog manually.

name: Fill in technology summary sheet
auto_rationale: This task can be partially automated, but requires human input for completion.
evidence: A technology summary sheet can also be filled in through the link
description: The team can fill in a technology summary sheet through the link.

name: Assign on-site or phone inspector
auto_rationale: This task involves decision-making based on criteria that can be partially automated.
evidence: ECN distinguishes new versus re-evaluation cases: for a new case it assigns an on-site inspector based on region and workload
description: ECN assigns an inspector based on case type and workload.

name: Collect missing documents
auto_rationale: This task requires physical presence and human interaction.
evidence: the inspector visits (or calls), collects any missing documents
description: The inspector collects any missing documents during the visit or call.

name: Write and upload inspection report
auto_rationale: This task can be partially automated, but requires human judgment for writing.
evidence: writes and uploads the inspection report to the inspection system.
description: The inspector writes and uploads the inspection report to the system.

name: Assign evaluator
auto_rationale: This task can be fully automated as it involves random assignment.
evidence: an evaluator is assigned at random
description: An evaluator is assigned at random after the inspection report is uploaded.

name: Check application information and documents
auto_rationale: This task requires human judgment to assess completeness.
evidence: The evaluator checks the application information, the inspection progress, and the issuance history, and reviews whether the documents are complete.
description: The evaluator checks the application information and whether documents are complete.

name: Issue supplementary request
auto_rationale: This task requires human judgment to determine what is missing.
evidence: If anything is missing, a supplementary request is issued.
description: If documents are missing, the evaluator issues a supplementary request.

name: Start investigation after consent
auto_rationale: This task requires human judgment and ethical considerations.
evidence: the investigation starts after a conflict-of-interest consent
description: The investigation starts after obtaining conflict-of-interest consent.

name: Enter company profile
auto_rationale: This task involves data entry that can be fully automated.
evidence: The company profile is entered first by the evaluation support team
description: The evaluation support team enters the company profile into the system.

name: Confirm company profile
auto_rationale: This task requires human judgment to verify the accuracy of the profile.
evidence: then confirmed by the evaluation team
description: The evaluation team confirms the entered company profile.

name: Pull data from corporate registry
auto_rationale: This task can be fully automated as it involves data retrieval.
evidence: pulled from the corporate registry or the shareholder register
description: Data is pulled from the corporate registry or shareholder register.

name: Check previous technology grade
auto_rationale: This task requires human judgment to interpret the grade.
evidence: We check the previous technology grade
description: The evaluator checks the previous technology grade.

name: Assess quality of inspection materials
auto_rationale: This task requires human judgment to evaluate quality.
evidence: after assessing the quality of the inspection materials we request a re-inspection if they are inadequate.
description: The evaluator assesses the quality of the inspection materials.

name: Request re-inspection
auto_rationale: This task requires human judgment to determine adequacy.
evidence: we request a re-inspection if they are inadequate.
description: The evaluator requests a re-inspection if materials are inadequate.

name: Carry over company information
auto_rationale: This task can be fully automated as it involves data transfer.
evidence: Company information is carried over from the previous evaluation.
description: Company information is carried over from the previous evaluation.

name: Confirm technology-evaluation target industry
auto_rationale: This task requires human judgment to confirm the industry.
evidence: we confirm the technology-evaluation target industry
description: The evaluator confirms the technology-evaluation target industry.

name: Search and select industrial-technology classification
auto_rationale: This task requires human judgment to select the appropriate classification.
evidence: search and select the industrial-technology classification
description: The evaluator searches and selects the industrial-technology classification.

name: Choose new-growth items and climate-technology classification
auto_rationale: This task requires human judgment to make selections.
evidence: choose new-growth items, climate-technology classification
description: The evaluator chooses new-growth items and climate-technology classification.

name: Update financial information manually
auto_rationale: This task requires manual input and cannot be automated.
evidence: Financial information cannot use scraping because of parsing-performance issues, so it is updated manually.
description: Financial information is updated manually due to scraping issues.

name: Write up main business areas and products
auto_rationale: This task requires human judgment to articulate the business areas.
evidence: We write up the main business areas, products, revenue share, and technologies.
description: The evaluator writes up the main business areas and products.

name: Pull representative patents from KIPRIS
auto_rationale: This task can be fully automated as it involves data scraping.
evidence: pull representative patents from KIPRIS via real-time scraping
description: Representative patents are pulled from KIPRIS via real-time scraping.

name: Select patents and read published full text
auto_rationale: This task requires human judgment to interpret the patent details.
evidence: select them, and read the published full text to confirm the 'problem to be solved' and the 'effect of the invention'
description: The evaluator selects patents and reads the published full text to confirm details.

name: Enter supporting basis for patents
auto_rationale: This task requires human judgment to determine the supporting basis.
evidence: enter the supporting basis.
description: The evaluator enters the supporting basis for the patents.

name: Generate draft technology-evaluation opinion
auto_rationale: This task can be fully automated as it involves generating text based on input.
evidence: A draft technology-evaluation opinion can also be generated with GPT.
description: A draft technology-evaluation opinion is generated using GPT.

name: Check on-site technology inspection items
auto_rationale: This task requires human judgment to evaluate the items.
evidence: there are eight items — management capability of the owner, management ability, technology-development capability, productization capability, profit outlook, technological innovativeness, market status, and product superiority.
description: The evaluator checks the eight on-site technology inspection items.

name: Produce rule-based score
auto_rationale: This task can be fully automated as it involves a straightforward calculation.
evidence: checking the boxes produces a rule-based score
description: Checking the boxes produces a rule-based score.

name: Auto-generate opinions via guidance
auto_rationale: This task can be fully automated as it involves generating text based on rules.
evidence: some opinions are auto-generated via guidance
description: Some opinions are auto-generated based on guidance.

name: Judge and select inspection items
auto_rationale: This task requires human judgment to make selections.
evidence: the evaluator judges, selects, edits, compares against the previous grade
description: The evaluator judges and selects inspection items based on the evaluation.

name: Save evaluation results
auto_rationale: This task involves data entry that can be fully automated.
evidence: and saves.
description: The evaluator saves the results of the evaluation.

name: Generate technology opinion
auto_rationale: This task can be fully automated as it involves generating text based on input.
evidence: the technology opinion is GPT-generated
description: The technology opinion is generated using GPT.

name: Review and edit technology opinion
auto_rationale: This task requires human judgment to review and edit the generated text.
evidence: the technology opinion is GPT-generated then reviewed and edited
description: The evaluator reviews and edits the GPT-generated technology opinion.

name: Copy-paste market opinion
auto_rationale: This task involves some automation but requires human judgment for finalization.
evidence: the market opinion is often copy-pasted from an existing report or TDB and then edited.
description: The evaluator often copy-pastes the market opinion from an existing report.

name: Confirm and write summary and detailed opinions
auto_rationale: This task requires human judgment to articulate the opinions.
evidence: the summary and detailed opinions for the eight items are confirmed and written.
description: The evaluator confirms and writes the summary and detailed opinions for the evaluation.

name: Confirm comprehensive evaluation grade
auto_rationale: This task requires human judgment to determine the grade.
evidence: the grade is confirmed
description: The evaluator confirms the comprehensive evaluation grade.

name: Auto-generate comprehensive opinion
auto_rationale: This task can be fully automated as it involves generating text based on input.
evidence: the comprehensive opinion is GPT auto-generated and written up.
description: The comprehensive opinion is auto-generated using GPT.

name: Request review of report
auto_rationale: This task requires human judgment to determine when to request a review.
evidence: Once the report is generated and a review is requested
description: The evaluator requests a review of the generated report.

name: Assign reviewer
auto_rationale: This task can be fully automated as it involves random assignment.
evidence: a reviewer is assigned at random
description: A reviewer is assigned at random for the report review.

name: Perform error and rule-based checks
auto_rationale: This task can be fully automated as it involves systematic checks.
evidence: the system automatically performs error and rule-based checks
description: The system automatically performs error and rule-based checks on the report.

name: Check qualitative items
auto_rationale: This task requires human judgment to evaluate qualitative aspects.
evidence: the reviewer checks the qualitative items.
description: The reviewer checks the qualitative items in the report.

name: Final approval of report
auto_rationale: This task requires human judgment and authority for approval.
evidence: the evaluation team leader's final approval
description: The evaluation team leader gives final approval for the report.

name: Dispatch report
auto_rationale: This task requires human action to send the report.
evidence: the report is dispatched.
description: The evaluation team leader dispatches the final report.
